Exterior: — Shared pool — Private patio — Balcony — 8-person outdoor dining — Direct beach access with two chairs and umbrella from March 1st to November 1st. — Paid Parking for up to 3 vehicles (1 covered, 2 in parking lot) ; Guests must pay $35/per vehicle when registering. Main floor: Kitchen, dining area, living room, 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 bedroom (2 queen beds), 1 full bathroom NeighborhoodThis home is situated in a prime location within Panama City Beach, offering a peaceful environment with unmatched, unobstructed views of the beach. The area is known for its stunning emerald waters and sugar-white sand, perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and coastal photography. During the summer, guests can enjoy endless water sports and community events along Front Beach Road. The winter season offers a quieter, serene atmosphere ideal for long beach walks. Nearby Rosemary Beach and Pier Park provide a variety of boutique shopping, local seafood dining, and entertainment options for all ages. TransitA car is recommended to fully explore the attractions of Panama City Beach and the nearby 30A communities. On-site parking is available for 3 vehicles, though guests must register their tag and unit number online via the link provided on signs throughout the premises. The beach is just a short walk of approximately 100 yards from your front door. AccessGuests will have access to the entire 1-story condominium. Shared community amenities include a pool and outdoor dining area. On-site parking is provided for 3 vehicles (1 covered space under the unit and 2 uncovered spaces in the lot). Beach access is steps beyond the pool from the property itself. Two chairs and umbrella set up on the beach by request.NotesPlease note there are 15 steps to enter our property. Please note shared pool may be closed due to unexpected repairs outside of our control. Please note to always check beach conditions. There is an additional charge of $35 per stay per vehicle to register at the property for STR guests
